body:
I suggest we change the v4 documentation section to actually reflect the rest of the requirements now that this is fleshed out well.

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
1.1 | Document all access control rules, including decision factors and environmental contexts. | ✓
1.2 | Ensure entitlement definitions align with specific consumer roles and resources. | ✓ ✓
1.3 | Outline function, data, and field-level access control mechanisms, specifying mitigation against IDOR, BOLA, and BOPLA. | ✓ ✓ ✓
1.4 | Define operational controls for immediate application of access control changes and mitigate information leakage risks. | ✓ ✓
1.5 | Document multi-tenant access restrictions and multi-layered security for administrative interfaces. | ✓ ✓ ✓
title: v4 documentation requirements
